objective: Turn an observed failure into a verified root-cause fix with the smallest durable change and explicit regression evidence.

stages.purpose: Bind the report to the current project baseline, capture expected versus observed behavior, and reproduce the failure or obtain the strongest available evidence without assuming historical evidence is still current.
stages.exit_when: The report has been reconciled with the current baseline and the failure is reproducible or sufficiently evidenced to localize without guessing.

stages.purpose: Trace the failure through the smallest relevant code/data/config path, distinguish cause from symptom, and treat issue comments/workarounds as hypotheses until tested.
stages.exit_when: A root-cause hypothesis predicts the observed failure and can be tested by a bounded change.

stages.purpose: Apply the narrowest durable fix and prove the failure no longer reproduces on the strongest practical relevant environment without collateral regression.
evidence: platform-specific compatibility evidence when exact reproduction is unavailable
verification-harness integrity evidence when a custom aggregator is material to the pass/fail claim
stages.exit_when: The original failure is fixed on a relevant baseline and regression evidence passes.

pressure_guards.rule: An issue, traceback, source line, or reproduction from an older version is historical evidence until compared with the current baseline; do not edit current code as though the old report were current fact.

Before the first material mutation in an existing project, reconcile the current implementation/runtime baseline with the project-defined authority and freshness of material state, specification, test, adapter, deployment, and historical evidence. A failing test can itself encode a stale historical assumption; classify that possibility before changing product behavior. Preserve material conflicts and keep unknown facts unknown rather than silently converting them to false/absent state.

When a custom test runner, CI wrapper, validation aggregator, generated report, or similar harness materially converts underlying checks into pass/fail acceptance evidence, do not trust a green aggregate merely because the wrapper exited successfully. Verify the smallest consequential integrity surface: intended checks are discovered distinctly, collisions/cached reuse/duplicate counting do not substitute one check for another, skipped/errored/unavailable work is represented honestly, and failures propagate through wrapper exit/status semantics. If harness integrity is unknown or disproven, downgrade the aggregate to provisional/unknown evidence and use direct underlying checks or repair the harness before relying on it for regression, completion, or release claims.
Issue comments, suggested fixes, and user workarounds are hypotheses/evidence, not verified root cause; test causality before adoption.

escalations.when: The issue is well-defined, reproducible, bounded, and should be delegated to a dedicated issue-solving agent instead of the current host.
escalations.selection_rule: Prefer mini-SWE-agent for a minimal bounded issue loop; choose OpenHands only when a broader autonomous coding environment is the actual need.

escalations.when: The bug is browser-visible and cannot be proven reliably with current tests/tools.
escalations.capability_gap: deterministic browser reproduction and regression validation
escalations.selection_rule: Prefer project Playwright Test when adding durable regression coverage; use CLI+Skills for agent-driven checks; use MCP for persistent exploratory browser state.

escalations.when: The project already uses Spec Kit or the defect must be reconciled with durable specification artifacts.
escalations.selection_rule: Use Spec Kit's supported bug workflow when it materially improves traceability; do not initialize a full SDD system solely for a trivial one-line defect.

verification: the current baseline corresponding to the fix is explicit
the original failure is no longer reproducible or the strongest equivalent compatibility evidence passes
a regression check guards the fixed behavior when practical
when a custom verification aggregator is material, its discovery/identity/failure-propagation integrity is credible enough for the acceptance claim rather than assumed from a green wrapper result
unrelated refactoring did not become the main change
reroute_signals: the failure is actually missing/changed product behavior -> feature-change
the repository cannot be trusted enough to localize the issue -> repo-recovery
